//: The repository's tooling: scripts/*.mts run as TypeScript straight from Node (22.18 or later strips the types itself), so nothing is emitted; this only type-checks them, in npm run lint. scripts/api-check/extension.ts is bundled by scripts/bundle.mts. They take their types from src/, which tsconfig.json compiles as CommonJS with parameter properties and value-style type imports, so verbatimModuleSyntax and erasableSyntaxOnly would fail on src/; the scripts keep to erasable syntax and import types with import type, which every run of them checks.
